SPACE CRAFT JOURNAL / PERSONAL PREFERENCES & WORKPLACE

Vastu tips for office interiors creating a personal workspace.

Make room for preferences with a clear brief. This Space Craft planning note looks at vastu tips for office interiors creating a personal workspace through the choices that affect everyday use, the details worth testing and the questions to take into your project brief.

Space Craft editorialPlanning note · 4 min read
IN THIS NOTEDiscuss meaning without promising outcomesKeep practical needs visibleChoose reversible expressionsMap activity before assigning desksBefore you decide
01 / DESIGN CONSIDERATION

Discuss meaning without promising outcomes

Some teams want cultural, seasonal or personal references within the office. Treat these as preferences to explore, without presenting a direction, object or plant as a guarantee of prosperity or health.

02 / DESIGN CONSIDERATION

Keep practical needs visible

Circulation, access, safety and comfort still need to guide the plan. Talk through any conflicts between a preferred arrangement and the needs of the people using it.

03 / DESIGN CONSIDERATION

Choose reversible expressions

A movable object, artwork or seasonal display may offer an appropriate way to express a preference. Plan storage and keep shared settings inclusive.

04 / DESIGN CONSIDERATION

Map activity before assigning desks

Write down the tasks people perform, how often teams overlap and when visitors arrive. A desk count alone will not reveal the need for private calls, project tables or storage.

BEFORE YOU DECIDE

Take this into your brief.

  • Record preferences as part of the brief.
  • Separate personal meaning from measurable design requirements.
  • Keep access and essential signs clear.

Write down one priority, one constraint and one question you still need to answer. Review them beside the plan or material sample before agreeing the next design decision.

General design considerations for discussion. Product suitability, technical performance, statutory requirements and project pricing need appropriate, project-specific review. Images are illustrative.
